import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int S, T, tot = 1, n, tt, inf;
    static int[] b = new int[1000];
    static int[] q = new int[1000000];
    static int[][] edge = new int[1000000][3];
    static int[] head = new int[1000];
    static int[][] s = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] dep = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] dis = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] pid = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] sgrid = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] grid = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] bgrid = new char[20][20];
    static int[] depth = new int[1000];

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edge[++tot][0] = v;
        edge[tot][1] = cap;
        edge[tot][2] = head[u];
        head[u] = tot;

        edge[++tot][0] = u;
        edge[tot][1] = 0;
        edge[tot][2] = head[v];
        head[v] = tot;
    }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy, boolean build) {
        int l = 1, r = 1, idx = pid[sx][sy];
        q[1] = sx * 1000 + sy;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                dis[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
            }
        }
        inf = dis[0][0];
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        
        while (l <= r) {
            int cx = q[l] / 1000;
            int cy = q[l++] % 1000;
            
            if (build && sgrid[cx][cy] != 0 && dis[cx][cy] <= tt && dis[cx][cy] <= dep[cx][cy]) {
                link(idx, sgrid[cx][cy], inf);
            }
            
            if (dis[cx][cy] > tt || dis[cx][cy] >= dep[cx][cy]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (idx == 3 && sgrid[cx][cy] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dis[cx][cy]);
            }
            
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dir[k][0];
                int ny = cy + dir[k][1];
                if (nx > 0 && nx <= n && ny > 0 && ny <= n && 
                    Character.isDigit(grid[nx][ny]) && dis[nx][ny] == inf) {
                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q[++r] = nx * 1000 + ny;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs_level() {
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0);
        int l = 1, r = 1;
        q[1] = S;
        depth[S] = 1;
        
        while (l <= r) {
            int u = q[l++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edge[i][2]) {
                int v = edge[i][0];
                if (depth[v] != 0 || edge[i][1] == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                q[++r] = v;
                if (v == T) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (u == T) {
            return f;
        }
        int used = 0;
        for (int i = head[u]; i != 0 && f - used > 0; i = edge[i][2]) {
            int v = edge[i][0];
            if (depth[v] != depth[u] + 1 || edge[i][1] == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            int pushed = dfs(v, Math.min(f - used, edge[i][1]));
            used += pushed;
            edge[i][1] -= pushed;
            edge[i ^ 1][1] += pushed;
        }
        if (used == 0) {
            depth[u] = -1;
        }
        return used;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        tt = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                bgrid[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                dep[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(dis[i], 0, dep[i], 0, 20);
        }
        
        int node_count = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] > '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    pid[i][j] = ++node_count;
                    link(S, pid[i][j], grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (bgrid[i][j] > '0' && bgrid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sgrid[i][j] = ++node_count;
                    link(sgrid[i][j], T, bgrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (pid[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxflow = 0;
        while (bfs_level()) {
            maxflow += dfs(S, inf);
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxflow);
    }
}
